mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the signal is active, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to higher prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a single month, it signals an inflationary environment with high borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 300,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 300,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the signal is active, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% in a single month and real GDP (GDPC1) shows a quarterly increase of more than 1%, it signals a strong supply-side expansion, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increase > 2% in 1 month and GDPC1 increase > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
